free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 a month with no credit card: USD 5 of compute credits every month, 20 concurrent runs, unlimited tasks, 5 team members, 10 schedules, 1 day log retention and 10 concurrent Realtime connections
free_tier.notes: The credit pays for seconds of compute by machine size plus an invocation charge per run (USD 0.000025); runs in the DEV environment are not charged. Once the credit is used, tasks stop until the next month or an upgrade.

retention.stated: 1 day of logs on the Free plan; a queued run expires after the 14-day maximum TTL

egress.terms: not stated: the pricing page charges compute seconds and runs and names no charge on traffic out of a task

interface_detail: The management API at api.trigger.dev takes an environment API key or a personal access token as a Bearer token, and the @trigger.dev/sdk package wraps it; the CLI runs tasks locally with hot reloading
tooling: the @trigger.dev/sdk package, the CLI and the web dashboard
chaining: A hosted runner for TypeScript tasks with no maximum run duration, so a long crawl or a chain of model calls runs off any free host until USD 5 of compute is spent.

limits.value: USD 5 of compute credits a month (a monetary credit, not bytes)
1 day of logs; queued runs expire after 14 days

limits_note: 10 schedules and 10 concurrent Realtime connections on the Free plan.
binding_note: The monthly USD 5 credit runs out first for a sustained workload: past it, tasks stop until the next month or an upgrade.

identity_cost.detail: No credit card required; the login page offers GitHub, Google, SSO or email.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; once the monthly credit is spent, tasks stop running until the next month or an upgrade
